title: 3 Wicketinu 365 Runs
overview: 'Moonu Wicketinu 365 Runs' is a wholly wasted exercise that should have better stayed inside the cans. By unearthing it and presenting it before an audience in 2015, they have only managed to exhibit a fossil of a film that is a matter of discomfiture to all concerned.
